title: Rollback Approval Evidence schema-package manifest
description: Governs manifest.json, the deterministic tamper-evidence and completeness manifest over schema_resources/rollback_approval's own schema resource files (Phase 149L; RAE-001 v1.0). Sits at the package root, outside records/, since it describes the package itself. Loaded and verified by src/pcae/schema_runtime/manifest.py:load_and_verify_manifest unchanged -- no schema_runtime code is modified by this package.

contract_version.description: The governing contract and version this manifest was generated against.

package.description: The schema package this manifest indexes.

entries.description: One entry per schema resource file in the package, in deterministic canonical order (sorted by file_path, ascending, ASCII byte order).

schema_id.description: Must match the entry's own schema file's declared $id exactly.

schema_version.description: Informational only; not cross-checked by load_and_verify_manifest, which carries no schema_version_key parameter.

file_path.description: Path relative to the rollback_approval package root. Forbids '..' and leading '/' by construction; the loader additionally verifies containment independent of this pattern.

file_digest.description: SHA-256 of the entry's own schema file's raw bytes, recomputed and compared at load time, never trusted from this claim alone.

family.description: The record_type value the file governs.

status.description: 'frozen' marks authoring-complete content committed for the registry to load; 'draft' must never appear in a committed manifest.
